passage.text: Our English exam is next Monday at nine o'clock in Room 5.
passage.reading: aʊr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪɡˈzæm ɪz ˈnɛkst ˈmʌndeɪ ət ˈnaɪn əˈklɑːk ɪn ˈruːm ˈfaɪv.

passage.text: Please prepare for it this weekend.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz prɪˈpɛr fər ɪt ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd.

passage.text: The exam is on chapters one to five of our book.
passage.reading: ði ɪɡˈzæm ɪz ɑːn ˈtʃæptərz ˈwʌn tə ˈfaɪv əv aʊr ˈbʊk.

passage.text: You must not use a dictionary or a phone in the exam room.
passage.reading: juː mʌst ˈnɑːt ˈjuːz ə ˈdɪkʃənɛri ɔːr ə ˈfoʊn ɪn ði ɪɡˈzæm ˌruːm.

passage.text: The exam is two hours long, so you don't have to hurry.
passage.reading: ði ɪɡˈzæm ɪz ˈtuː ˈaʊərz ˈlɔːŋ, soʊ juː ˈdoʊnt ˈhæf tə ˈhɜːri.

passage.text: Come to my office on Thursday afternoon.
passage.reading: ˈkʌm tə maɪ ˈɔːfɪs ɑːn ˈθɜːrzdeɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn.

passage.text: See you on Monday, and don't worry!
passage.reading: ˈsiː juː ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ, ənd ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri!
